sre-alerts: [ALERT] hosted-infer-usw2 p99 request latency > SLO for 15m — SLO burn: 2.3% (alert=A-2389)
Support Ops: Customer 'AcmeCorp' escalated — they see intermittent 502/504 and 504 timeouts from the hosted inference API. Example request_id=rrc-7f2e3b, client_ip=203.0.113.45, sdk=python-requests/1.4.2
Alyssa (oncall): @Support Ops can you paste proxy + router logs for rrc-7f2e3b and the payload size? Any traces available?
Support Ops: Logs for rrc-7f2e3b:
```
proxy: 2025-06-05T10:12:22Z request_id=rrc-7f2e3b upstream_status=504 upstream_time=30004 client_conn_closed=true
router: 2025-06-05T10:12:22Z request_id=rrc-7f2e3b model=redwood-llm-large status=timeout
```
Support Ops: Customer provided their repro curl (they say hits happen ~1/200 requests):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"input":"<~60KB payload>"}' --max-time 5
```
Support Ops: Billing/auth dashboards show no auth errors for that org. They also attached a pcap.
Kevin: I'm seeing trace gaps — Jaeger has proxy span but no downstream server spans for these request_ids. Network shows TCP FIN from client side right around the 30s mark. Suspect client aborts hitting their own timeout -> upstream sees closed connection -> 504.
Maria: We should try to reproduce by forcibly aborting the client socket. Quick local reproducer (python):
```
import requests, socket, threading, time
# open request then close socket after 2s to simulate abort
```
Alyssa (oncall): Short-term mitigations: increase gateway upstream_read_timeout for the AcmeCorp route from 30s -> 45s, and enable 100% trace sampling for that org so we capture full spans. Also add X-Debug-Id header echoing request_id to make log/jointing easier.
Samir: I'll spin up a fallback route that pins AcmeCorp traffic to the small-model pool (lower tail latency) as a canary. Plan: add route + traffic-shift + rollback. ETA ~1h. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Useful log query (Datadog/ELK) to find similar events:
```
# find proxy entries with client closed + long upstream times
index=proxy_logs | where upstream_time > 25000 and client_conn_closed == true | stats count() by client_ip
```
Support Ops: Customer sent pcap and their SDK team confirmed their client aborts at ~30s when internal retry/backoff kicks in. They will try a client-side config change but asked for server-side guardrails.
Maria: Long-term: add metric client_abort_rate and instrument TLS keepalive/connection-reset events. Also add a server-side graceful abort handler so model pools get explicit cancel signals and we don't waste long-running work.
Alyssa (oncall): Action items recorded:
- Samir: create canary fallback route for AcmeCorp -> small-model pool (ETA 1h)
- Kevin: enable 100% trace sampling for AcmeCorp + add X-Debug-Id logging (ETA 30m)
- Support Ops: collect full pcap + SDK version + exact repro steps from customer and paste here (ETA 15m)
- Maria: draft RFC for client_abort_rate metric + abort handling design (ETA EOD)
If SLO burn continues after mitigations, we escalate paging. I'll open oncall ticket and link here. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
